exposure: Severity of idiopathic polyhydramnios (mild vs. moderate-severe)
finding: Term pregnancies with idiopathic polyhydramnios, especially moderate-severe ones are at a significantly increased rate for adverse pregnancy outcomes including IUFD, macrosomia, malpresentation, cesarean delivery, and low APGAR scores at 5 min.
mod_finding: Term pregnancies with idiopathic polyhydramnios had higher rates of Cesarean delivery.
